how: Not re-run. Numbers and sentences below were copied from the committed source note; the verdict is the line as written there.
why: In the Phase 1 Daily (1D) event study, classical pitchfork geometry exhibited high Median Line reach (86.15% to 90.03%), but naive market entries suffered small negative fee drag (-0.95% to -1.12% per trade).
This severely shrinks the remaining reward while leaving the full stop-loss distance intact, producing negative returns (-0.16% to -1.31%) across every test condition.
Placing resting limit orders at the active tine ($LML$ for longs, $UML$ for shorts) completely eliminates negative fee drag.

In naive confirmation entries, the average winning trade captured only +1.58% to +2.11% because price had already completed 40%-60% of the journey toward the Median Line before the entry bar closed. Meanwhile, the stop loss remained fixed at -2.0% or below $P…
